subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should pending BOOTSTRAP.md with no setupCompletedAt require explicit user-content or deletion evidence instead of accepting profile-file diffs or preseeded skills as completion evidence?
rationale: The patch fixes the managed-workspace bug by narrowing a shipped completion heuristic, but that changes behavior for existing pending workspaces and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the narrowed pending-bootstrap rule
options.body: Land after docs and CI are clean, treating profile diffs and preseeded skills as insufficient while BOOTSTRAP.md is still pending.

options.title: Require an explicit managed-workspace mode
options.body: Ask for a config or migration design if legacy profile-diff repair must remain the default behavior for existing workspaces.

options.title: Pause for broader bootstrap policy
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want to redesign bootstrap completion semantics more broadly.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed pending-bootstrap rule
recommendation.body: Land after docs and CI are clean, treating profile diffs and preseeded skills as insufficient while BOOTSTRAP.md is still pending.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen introduced the stale bootstrap completion behavior being narrowed, so they are the strongest history-backed routing owner for the compatibility decision.
